mechanism: Emulated option constructions (Long Call/Put, Short Call/Put) expose a total_delta via UpdateOptionConstructionDelta(price) that sums per-option sigmoid deltas at the live underlying price. That continuous delta maps into discrete emulation levels (±0…10) which drive rebalancing of the net underlying position—so delta itself is the directional/regime sensor that decides long, flat, or short exposure.
data_needed: Tick ask/bid (or mid) of the underlying; option-construction type; sigmoid K/S parameters; ADR/HV for strike/level spacing; min lot step and MinLotsMultiplier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD example; daily options with same-day ForceAutoExpirationTime; tick-driven OnTick rebalance; ADRDaysNumber=20 for HV
why_new_for_mis: Treats portfolio Greeks delta of an emulated option book as a live regime/exposure sensor that can be read without a listed options chain—MIS can monitor delta path and level flips as state.

mechanism: Delta for level decisions is computed on (ask+bid)/2 rather than on ask or bid alone, explicitly to reduce dependence of delta changes on spread fluctuations; ask-delta and bid-delta are still logged but mid drives UpdateOptionLevel.
data_needed: Live SymbolInfoTick ask and bid; option construction object.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Underlying with a quoted spread (EURUSD demo); tick resolution
why_new_for_mis: Separates microstructure spread noise from the sensing quote used for regime/delta—MIS can adopt midquote as the canonical input when sensing levels near the spread.
quote: Note that we take the average between Bid and Ask as the price for calculating the current delta of the option construction. This helps reduce the dependence of delta changes on spread changes.

mechanism: Instead of a fixed ADR/HV lookback, scan window lengths wnd from OptimizeDayNumberMin..Max (default 3..40). For each wnd: take daily ranges (high−low), MedianHV(wnd)=median of those ranges, Error[i]=|range[i]−MedianHV|, MedianErr=median(Error). Pick the wnd with minimum MedianErr and use its MedianHV as today’s HV. Recalculate once per new day.
data_needed: D1 OHLC CopyRates for the symbol; min/max day window bounds; MathMedian from MT5 Stat library.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any underlying with D1 history; HV refreshed at day open / EA restart; option levels scaled to that HV
why_new_for_mis: Data-driven HV horizon selection by median absolute deviation from the median range—MIS gets an adaptive daily-range volatility sensor that auto-tunes lookback without fixed windows.
quote: By varying the window length from three to forty … we select the window with the minimum average deviation from the actual values. … We use medians to exclude extremely high and extremely low historical volatility values.

mechanism: For long-option constructions (Rising, Long Straddle, Long Strangle), when UseExpirationPriceLevel is on and the live rebalancing level reaches ExpirationPriceLevel, compare bid/ask to the precomputed Up/DnPriceLevel_Array[ExpirationPriceLevel−1] and force early expiration (close all, stop until next day). Level index is chosen from HV statistics or tester optimization.
data_needed: live_option_level_sign/value; UpPriceLevel_Array / DnPriceLevel_Array from HV; ExpirationPriceLevel int; bid/ask.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Emulated option structures on underlying; intraday levels; daily restart after force-expire
why_new_for_mis: Converts HV-scaled rebalance depth into a discrete regime-change / take-profit event—MIS can treat ‘HV-level N hit’ as a typed change sensor, not just a trade exit.
quote: it would be advisable to close out the option structure early when the price of the underlying asset reaches a statistically justified level (here and below, this refers to the rebalancing levels of the option structure).

mechanism: Short Straddle/Strangle books are capped by adding Long Put/Call wings whose strikes/norms are HV multiples (ButterflyKoeffStrike, ButterflyKoeffNorm). Beyond the working HV region, total delta peaks then decays toward zero (‘Butterfly zone’), so position size is automatically unwound if price travels into fat-tail territory. Non-monotonic delta requires separate bisection level calculators for working vs butterfly segments.
data_needed: Daily adaptive HV; ButterflyKoeffStrike/Norm; short straddle/strangle core; Up/Dn butterfly level arrays.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Underlying with HV-scaled levels; Short STRADDLE/STRANGLE + Butterfly constructions; day-scoped structures
why_new_for_mis: Encodes fat-tail risk as an HV-multiple sensing boundary where exposure must collapse—MIS can monitor distance-to-butterfly-zone as a volatility-regime proximity metric.
quote: The strike prices of these options must lie beyond the maximum option levels in both the positive and negative DPrice regions … when the price of the underlying asset continues to rise or fall, our losses do not increase.

mechanism: Article states historical volatility clustering (high-vol periods cluster; strong moves followed by strong moves) as empirical fact contradicting independent increments, and defers a dedicated clustering test/application to the next part—still a sensing premise for MIS even without the follow-on code here.

quote: Historical volatility is not constant: periods of high volatility tend to cluster together. The same is true of periods of low volatility. A strong move is usually followed by a series of other strong moves.

mechanism: GetEma copies EMA buffer then labels regime: if EMA[1] is strictly above both High[1] and Low[1] of the last closed bar → SELL/SHORT regime and sellOk only if that bar is bearish (close<open); if EMA[1] strictly below both High and Low → BUY/LONG regime and buyOk only if bullish. Flat otherwise. Entries fire once per new bar via closedCandleTime.
data_needed: iMA EMA handle (period/shift inputs); OHLC of bar 1 on tradingTimeframe; new-bar time gate.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; tradingTimeframe default PERIOD_H1; emaPeriod=20; tester Nov 2022–Nov 2023 every-tick
why_new_for_mis: Regime is not ‘price vs EMA’ but full-bar containment (entire candle on one side of EMA) plus candle color—stricter trend filter for MIS regime labels.
quote: Buy Entry: Open a buy position when the most recently closed candle is a buy candle, and both it's low and high prices are above the exponential moving average (EMA).

mechanism: Tracks accountPercentageProfit = (buy+sell position profit)*100/startingCapital from equity at init/flat; ManageProfitAndLoss liquidates all magic-matched positions when profit ≥ target % or ≤ −loss %, or when maxPositions reached with profit>0. Complements SL/TP.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_EQUITY startingCapital; summed POSITION_PROFIT for EA magic/symbol; accountPercentageProfitTarget/LossTarget inputs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY H1 OOP backtest Jan 2023–Mar 2024; also same logic in Part 1 EURUSD

mechanism: CTrailingClassic::FindExtremum CopyHigh (long) or CopyLow (short) on PERIOD_M1 from pos.TimeOpen() to TimeCurrent(), takes ArrayMaximum/Minimum, then sets SL to extremum∓m_diff_extremum (optional StepModify). Path extreme since entry is the sensed quantity that moves the stop.
data_needed: Position open time, symbol, direction; M1 high/low series since open; DiffExtremum and StepModify distances.

why_new_for_mis: Senses realized path extrema of an open trade (not chart indicator) as the trailing reference—MIS can reuse ‘since-entry extreme’ as a trade-local volatility/run sensor.
quote: Returns the extreme price reached while holding the position. For a long position, it will return the highest reached price. For a short one - the lowest price that was reached.

series_key: universal expert advisor: a custom trailing stop
mechanism: CTrailingMoving sets position SL equal to Moving.OutValue(1) (prior completed MA bar); if price is already beyond that MA (buy and value>CurrentPrice, or sell and value<CurrentPrice) it CloseAtMarket—so MA acts as both trail level and hard exit sensor.
data_needed: CIndMovingAverage (or shared strategy Moving) OutValue(1); position direction and CurrentPrice.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: CImpulse strategy MA; chart working TF of the strategy
why_new_for_mis: Composable trailing module where an indicator level is the sole exit/trail sensor—MIS can plug any level series into the same Modify contract.
quote: it sets a stop-loss level of a position equal to the moving average. … if the current price is below (when buying) or above (when selling) the calculated stop loss level, the position should be closed at current market prices.

mechanism: On a futures chart, collect all related unexpired futures via NameBasisSymbol() scan of SymbolsTotal; for each, days=(ExpirationDate−Now)/86400, per=(Last−BaseRate)/BaseRate*100, per_in_year=per/days*365, with BaseRate from spot (e.g. USDRUB_TOD*ContractSize for Si). Panel shows annualized rate vs days-to-expiry—the term-structure / implied-rate profile.

series_key: universal expert advisor: pending orders and hedging support
mechanism: At each new bar, place/modify BuyStop at Ask*(1+m_percent/100) and SellStop at Bid*(1−m_percent/100) (input StopPercent, e.g. 0.05–0.20%). Fill within the bar = impulse breakout event; unfilled orders are re-anchored next bar. Orders deleted if target falls on the wrong side of Moving Average to avoid instant MA-exit.
data_needed: Ask/Bid; m_percent; MA OutValue; PendingOrders environment; new-bar MarketEvent.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Strategy symbol/TF; hedging and netting account variants; MA period 28 example

quote: If the price makes a sudden movement (impulse) within a bar, then this order will be filled, and the Expert Advisor will enter during the strong price movement.

series_key: universal expert advisor: custom strategies and auxiliary trade classes
mechanism: CChannel InitBuy: on new bar, if Close[1] > UPPER_BAND[1] open long; InitSell if Close[1] < LOWER_BAND[1]; Support exits when Close[1] crosses back through BASE_LINE. iBands period and StdDev are strategy parameters—break of ±kσ band is the volatility-expansion entry sensor.
data_needed: iBands handle (PeriodBands, StdDev); Close[1]; UPPER/LOWER/BASE buffers.
why_new_for_mis: Classic σ-band break as a volatility-regime entry with mean-line exit—clear MIS volatility/change pair on any TF.
quote: If the current price is above the upper Bollinger band, we will buy. Conversely, if the current bar close price is below the lower Bollinger band, we will sell. We will exit long and short positions once the price reaches the middle line of the indicator.

series_key: universal expert advisor: integration with standard metatrader modules of signals
mechanism: Two CSignalAdapter instances: RSI pattern 1 (reverse behind oversold≤30 / overbought≥70) for entries; AC pattern 2 (three same-color bars above/below zero) for opposite-side exits. Each adapter locks one pattern index so entry and exit change events come from different oscillators without bit-mask collisions.
data_needed: CSignalRSI (PeriodRSI input) and CSignalAC via MqlSignalParams; bar-open MarketEvent; LongSignal/ShortSignal flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart Symbol/Period; RSI period input default 14; bar-open evaluation (every_tick=false)
why_new_for_mis: Composable multi-signal change bus—MIS can fuse heterogeneous pattern adapters (OB/OS reverse vs AC momentum exhaustion) as typed entry/exit events.
quote: Buying: Reverse behind the level of overselling — the oscillator turns upwards and its value at the analyzed bar is behind the level of overselling (default value is 30). … Closing Buy: The value of the AC indicator is above 0, and it falls at the analyzed and at two previous bars.
